prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Build responsive WordPress site with booking/payment functionality
Help provide 24/7 WordPress website management, including maintenance services for serious website owners and white-label site management for agencies and freelancers. PHP, WordPress, HTML, and CSS skills needed. Part-time, flexible hours.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Keep it under 150 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need a responsive WordPress site with booking and payment functionality, plus reliable 24/7 management and maintenance for ongoing use.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience building web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. While my background is broader than WordPress alone, I’m comfortable working on front-end and back-end implementation, responsive layouts, and payment flows, and I can support flexible part-time work with attention to stability and maintainability.

I’d approach this by making the booking and payment experience clear, mobile-friendly, and easy to manage, while keeping the site structure clean for ongoing updates and maintenance.

Would you like the booking flow to support specific availability rules or payment types?
